title: Madd and ghunnah in Ya-Sin 9 to 12; half-term recitation check: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y10 lesson 16 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Madd and ghunnah in Ya-Sin 9 to 12; half-term recitation check rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 16. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

panels.title: The half-term check
points: Plus your Juz' 'Amma block of the day

panels.title: Break plan
points: Ya-Sin 13 to 24 at home (checked after the break)

questions.q: Self-check: recite 36:9 to 12 and score each rubric row.
Recitation check: recite 36:1 to 12 and your block to the teacher one by one. While waiting, write your break plan on the pupil PDF and revise in pairs.
questions.a: Rubric scores and one target per pupil in the portal.

questions.q: Extend: plan which days you will learn 36:13 to 24.
questions.a: e.g. three ayat every two days.

questions.q: Stretch: read 36:13 to 16 with the mushaf and mark the rules.

options: home hifdh over the break, checked after
questions.a: A) home hifdh over the break, checked after. In the founding year, weeks 4 to 6 of the unit are home hifdh, checked briefly and caught up later.

questions.q: Think again: Ramadan is coming: the month of the Qur'an. What will your daily Qur'an look like for four weeks?
questions.a: Ya-Sin 1 to 24 (13 to 24 at home), the Juz' 'Amma rota and Al-Mulk: 10 to 15 minutes, logged.
